name: Acetaminophen
description: Corporate pain relief that keeps you working through injuries. Side effects include loyalty and decreased critical thinking.

name: Stimulant
description: Corporate alertness in a vial. Restores 20 TP and clears Sleep. Your break is now cancelled.

name: Hot Links
description: Aggressively spicy corporate sausages. Restores 100 HP. Served at a legally defensible temperature.

name: Spicy Burrito
description: A tightly wrapped meal with suspicious structural integrity. Restores 150 HP.

name: Energy Drink
description: Liquid overtime. Restores 30 MP. The crash is your personal responsibility.

name: Necklace Piece 1
description: First piece of a mysterious necklace found in Timbuc Cellar. Gives Rex strange visions when touched. Seems to be part of something bigger.

name: Complete Necklace
description: The completed necklace artifact. Acts as a focusing lens/USB drive for the Anti-ASP AI. Glows with an eerie blue light when Rex is nearby.

name: Smelly Key #1
description: A rusty key with a foul odor. Found inside a dead mutant rat in Timbuc's sewers. Smells like decay and desperation.

name: Rabinex
description: Acme Rabinex: clears Rabies. Side effects may include spontaneous tax fraud.

name: Engine
description: The stolen crane engine recovered for Zack. Heavy, oily, and essential to repairing the bridge.

name: Smelly Key #2
description: A corroded key found at the bottom of a sewer drain in Timbuc. Smells like decades of waste and regret.

name: Smelly Key #3
description: A grimy key baked into a questionable meat pie from a Timbuc street vendor. Smells like mystery meat and poor food safety standards.

name: Smelly Key #4
description: A tarnished key found in the waste disposal unit of Timbuc 2's B.M.N.E.C. Smells like disinfectant and failed experiments.

name: Smelly Key #5
description: A sticky key found in the trash behind 'The Busted Flush' bar. Smells like spilled synthetic spirits and broken dreams.

name: Smelly Key #6
description: A slimy key found in a puddle of unknown origin on Planet Ork. Smells like sulfur and poor life choices.

name: Smelly Key #7
description: The final key, held by Niles's ex. Smells like revenge and expensive perfume. Requires retrieving embarrassing childhood photos of Niles first.

name: Armortech Token
description: Company scrip accepted by Armortech gear dispensers. Five tokens buy a piece of equipment. No refunds, naturally.

name: Necklace Piece 2
description: Second piece of the mysterious necklace found in B.M.N.E.C. Guarded by a Trash Octopus. Pulses with strange energy when near Rex.

name: Necklace Piece 3
description: Third piece of the mysterious necklace found on Planet Ork. Protected by sonic-screaming bats. Emits a low hum that only Rex can hear.

name: Necklace Piece 4
description: Final piece of the mysterious necklace found in the Floating Mansion. Guarded by holographic laser-sharks. Seems to react to Rex's implant.

name: Engine Blueprint
description: A revolutionary engine design from Armatek. Requires three components to build.

name: Engine Component A
description: A component for the revolutionary engine. Found at the construction site.

name: Engine Component B
description: A component for the revolutionary engine. Salvaged from an A.S.P. drone.

name: Engine Component C
description: A component for the revolutionary engine. Acquired from an Armatek official.

name: Completed Engine
description: A revolutionary engine that could change the world. Built from the blueprint and three components.

name: Disco Implant
description: Zed's prototype mood enhancer. Side effect: causes uncontrollable disco dancing at inappropriate moments.

name: Third Eye Mod
description: Zed's perception enhancer. Side effect: you can see bad puns floating above people's heads. Cannot unsee.

name: Mysterious Burlap Package
description: A suspicious package containing scratchy burlap pants. The label reads 'Productivity Enhancement Garment - Property of Armatek'.

name: Productivity Fabric Sample
description: A swatch of itchy burlap fabric with microscopic mind-control nanites woven in. Wearing it makes you want to work overtime.

name: SEAM-3000 Control Module
description:
The brain behind mandatory burlap trousers.
Now accepting a strongly worded resignation.

name: Court Summons
description: Official summons to the underground Clown Court. Charges include 'Insufficient Whimsy' and 'Failure to Appreciate Balloon Animals'.

name: Pie-Based Evidence
description: Cream pie with evidence baked inside. The only form of evidence accepted in Clown Court. Tastes like justice and banana cream.

name: Vending Machine Manifesto
description: Manifesto of the Snack Liberation Front. Demands include 'fair pricing for all snacks' and 'the right to dispense unsolicited advice'.

name: Premium Grade Lubricant
description: Premium lubricant for vending machine negotiations. The label reads 'Guaranteed to smooth even the most stuck-up coin slots'.

name: Niles's Embarrassing Photos
description: Photos of Niles as a child dressed as a corporate mascot. His ex will trade the final Smelly Key for these. Handle with care (and gloves).

name: Alien Research Notes
description: Detailed documentation of alien STD experiments. Contains disturbing diagrams and the phrase 'human subjects responded enthusiastically (after sedation).'

name: Ship Transponder
description: A small device salvaged from the alien ship. Pressing the large red button summons the Marcus Garvey 2.0 to your location. Warning: May cause mild probing sensations.

name: Golden Gear
description: An ornate golden gear with strange runes etched into its teeth. Despite its ancient appearance, it seems to be a crucial component for modern machinery.

name: Jen's Necklace
description: A silver necklace with a blue pendant that belongs to Jen. It appears to be her only memento from before the corporate wars.

name: Dungeon Field Notes
description:
Review dungeon objectives, directions, and hints.
Reusable; select from Key Items outside battle.

name: Expedition Notes
description:
Room clues and objectives for six maze expeditions.
Reusable: Key Items, then confirm the party.

name: Experimental Neural Enhancer
description: One of Zed's experimental neural mods. Side effect: randomly swaps your limbs. 'It's a feature, not a bug!' - Zed

name: Bible
description: The Holy Bible

name: Alien Dick's Pistol
description: Seemingly belonged to an alien private eye.

name: Fire Canon
description: It's marshmellow time!

description:
